items.prompt:
The main point of an informational text is its:
A) central idea
B) title font
C) page count

An OBJECTIVE summary:
A) states key ideas without opinion
B) adds your judgment
C) is very long
items.answer: A) states key ideas without opinion

solution.answer: A) states key ideas without opinion

items.prompt:
A central idea is built and refined by:
A) specific details
B) the cover
C) the page number

steps: Details refine it. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

Urbanization is accelerating: over half the world now lives in cities, and the share is projected to keep rising.

The central idea is that urbanization is:
A) accelerating
B) reversing
C) unimportant

steps: Main point refined by data. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which is an OBJECTIVE summary of that passage?
A) The world is obviously ruining itself by crowding into cities.
B) Urbanization is accelerating, with over half the world in cities and rising.
C) I think cities are great.
items.answer: B) Urbanization is accelerating, with over half the world in cities and rising.

solution.answer: B) Urbanization is accelerating, with over half the world in cities and rising.

items.prompt:
A central idea is SHAPED AND REFINED by:
A) the specific details the author chooses
B) the title alone
C) the font
items.answer: A) the specific details the author chooses

solution.answer: A) the specific details the author chooses

items.prompt:
Read.

Gene editing could cure inherited diseases, but it also raises concerns about safety and about 'designing' humans.

The central idea is that gene editing:
A) is useless
B) offers great promise yet raises serious ethical concerns
C) should be banned outright
items.answer: B) offers great promise yet raises serious ethical concerns

solution.answer: B) offers great promise yet raises serious ethical concerns

items.prompt:
Which sentence does NOT belong in an objective summary of an article on tourism?
A) Tourism increased local revenue.
B) Tourism is clearly a blessing everyone should welcome without question.
C) Tourism strained water and housing.
items.answer: B) Tourism is clearly a blessing everyone should welcome without question.

solution.answer: B) Tourism is clearly a blessing everyone should welcome without question.
